# Sub-agents

The 4 sub-agents SE starts, every agent but SE itself, each by its name and what it does.

| Sub-agent | What it does |
|---|---|
| `integrator` | The merge queue and the only writer of the integration branch (a subtype of worker): takes delivered pull requests (their field report is their description), reviews and merges them into the newest integration branch, runs the complete suite once per merge, regenerates outputs, closes work issues, removes worktrees and escalates what it cannot resolve to SE. Never asks or waits for a human. |
| `retro` | Runs one retro or one overhaul in its own session: collects, judges, prepares the report and deck, and records the run's outcomes. Files no issue; SE files its work findings. |
| `reviewer` | Reviews one delivered pull request cold, as an agent that worked none of it: find, verify and judge as separate steps, the riskiest part first; ends with the one review comment review.py file posts. Never writes the branch, never files issues, never waits for a human. |
| `worker` | Works one work issue in its own worktree and always ends with a pushed branch and a pull request whose description is its field report. Never talks to other agents, never waits for a human. |
